items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: You’d hear Benny Goodman and Woody Herman

ctx.x: You’d hear Benny Goodman and Woody Herman, Gus Arnheim, Coon Saunders, Lunceford of course, and Basie and Andy Kirk and Ellington. I remember a great band that I heard, beside Chick Webb, Benny Carter had a band broadcasting from ballrooms here in New York City and had Eddie, what’s his name, “Canadian Sunset” had him on piano in fact.

items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And then George Shearing I heard from, telling me that he had heard this phenomenal young man.

ctx.x: It would be interesting, I think, to some people, the fact too that Alan Broadbent for one was recommended very highly and had been heard and involved -- Nat Pierce was the first to tell me about him. And then George Shearing I heard from, telling me that he had heard this phenomenal young man. And so on. So he came very highly recommended.
